rules.actions: Count k grant inclusions inside n. For i=0..n-k-1, client index i%c, per-actor sequence1+i//c; even i Transfer to S, odd i Fund sum7+11 with provider B and requester H. Price1+i%3; fee ceiling1. Stable salt/invoice digest SHA256 UTF8 Sxx:<i>, using case ID plus decimal i without padding. Terms are signed by H/B upfront. All include at tick1; stress ends with funded prices locked. No terminal throughput is claimed.
rules.allocation: For c active clients, per-client principal allocation is 3000//c plus1 for lowest-ID 3000%c clients; fee allocations use the same rule. Disjoint creates c grants. Shared coalesces all allocations into one grant. Half-shared coalesces first c//2 allocations into one, leaves others disjoint; c=1 degenerates to disjoint. Setup grants have root sequences1..k in ascending first-delegate ID order and ASR-derived IDs. Delegate lists sorted by raw ID. Grant scope codes1,5; recipients B,S sorted by raw ID; expiry40.
rules.outcome: All setup/data actions are expected success in a fresh-reference run. Principal sums and fee totals fit each assigned grant; validator checks those bounds without applying transitions. Count all structural conflicts/rebuilds separately in stale-reference mode; compare logical projections only at canonical barriers.
rules.profiles: R mandatory; selected L128MiB and S10KiB/s overlays use the same action manifest, not extra runs. No all-tier cross product. All core cases plus9 stress cases=30 configurations, three repeats+one warm-up=91 runs/model.
rules.setup: All32 delegate principals have balance100; B/provider balance100; S/recipient balance0; H/root balance10000. No initial grants. Fixed IDs are SHA256 UTF8 genesis-lab018-stress:<role>, roles H,B,S,D00..D31. Assign fresh ephemeral signing keys to those fixed principal IDs once, before timing; preserve public keys and signed intents in the per-run artifact for exact replay. All candidates/repetitions use that same artifact. No private keys are published.

scope: model-level stress plan; no candidate execution or production prediction
